frontier.definition: d_j=[F_j:ℚ]; K_j=F_j(s), E_j=K_j(ω), ℛ_j=O_Kj[ω], τ fixes K_j. C_j is the entire integral box of fixed radius T* at all places; n_j=|C_j|. Z_j=(C_j−ωC_j)\{0}. ν_j=#{(zℛ_j,zτ(z)):z∈Z_j}.
frontier.quantified_obligation: There exist constants γ>0, C₁<∞ and j₀, independent of j, such that for every j≥j₀ one has ν_j≤C₁(n_j²−1)e^(−γd_j).
frontier.conditional_consequence: If this holds, then for every fixed 0<c<γ/[3log(2T*+1)], the complete real square has |Q(A_j,A_j)|≤n_j^{2−c} eventually. The origin contributes at most one output.
